body:
I tried Deschloroketamine (D) as an alternative to Ketamine/MXE.  I am experienced with K and MXE, and have had minimal negative, long-term side effects with frequent use.
0:00 - Insufflated ~30mg crushed crystals of D.
0:10 - Began feeling the effects - similar to MXE, but less familiar and warm. Drip feels normal, not too painful.
0:30 - Dissociative effects are feeling similar to that of MXE - new thought patterns, more relaxed mind and body, feeling of release. However, there is a notable pressure in my sinuses that is somewhat uncomfortable.
0:45 - Uncomfortable feeling has persisted and I am quite certain it is due to the D.
1:30 - 1.5 hours in, feeling remains similar to MXE but less warm and less euphoric. D feels slightly more metallic/digital as opposed to earthy/analog. Felt urge to reup, but resisted due to questionable nature of the displeasure I was feeling in my sinuses.
...the next day - the experience lasted longer than ketamine, but shorter than MXE... approx 3 hours of fun, plus 2-3 hours of alertness, mild irritability, and insomnia. Head and sinus aches lead me to not want to try this again. Use with caution.
